title: Assistente de operações
description:
Na RPS temos um compromisso com a excelência e a satisfação do cliente. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais experientes e dedicados que ajudam no desenvolvimento de serviços no mercado imobiliário.


Descrição da Vaga – (Assistente de Operações - Alphaville e região)

O Assistente de Operações, desempenha um papel crucial no suporte ao Gestor Condominial, concentrando-se na gestão eficiente da rotina administrativa e financeira do condomínio. 


Atuando como o elo estratégico entre o Departamento Financeiro da RPS e as nuances do dia a dia do condomínio, o profissional se destaca pela habilidade em manter uma comunicação fluida e eficaz. Respeitando com precisão as diretrizes e normas estabelecidas pela empresa, o Assistente de Operações é encarregado de garantir a conformidade dos procedimentos e processos implantados. Além disso, é esperado que o profissional compartilhe proativamente suas percepções, desafios e ideias com o Gestor Condominial, contribuindo para a evolução constante das práticas operacionais.


Em última análise, o Assistente de Operações é fundamental para a execução de suas responsabilidades diárias com padrões elevados de excelência


1. Principais Responsabilidades


1.1 Atuar como suporte ao Gestor Condominial, facilitando a integração entre o Departamento Financeiro e as operações diárias do condomínio.

1.2 Auxiliar nas atividades administrativas e financeiras do condomínio, assegurando a conformidade com os procedimentos e processos estabelecidos pela empresa.

1.3 Reportar regularmente ao Gestor Condominial, compartilhando desafios, sugestões e contribuindo para o aprimoramento contínuo das operações.

1.4 Executar as tarefas diárias com precisão e excelência.

1.5 Avaliar fornecedores do condomínio e formalizar rescisões quando necessário;

1.6 Preparar e participar de Assembleias Gerais e reuniões de conselho dos condomínios, propondo melhorias;

1.7 Realizar reuniões com interlocutores do condomínio, estabelecendo calendário de visitas mensais

1.8 Acompanhar rotinas de manutenção preventiva e corretiva predial, assegurando a execução dos serviços no cronograma operacional e o bom funcionamento das áreas comuns.


2. Competências Requeridas


2.1. Conhecimento em administração condominial e operações prediais;

2.2. Familiaridade com processos financeiros e contratuais;

2.3. Se comunicar verbalmente e por escrito, essencial para interagir com clientes, fornecedores e colegas de trabalho, capacidade de gerenciar tarefas múltiplas e priorizar eficientemente.

2.4. Habilidade em acompanhamento de equipes, incluindo terceirizadas e atividades multifuncionais.

2.5. Fortes habilidades de negociação .


3. Requisitos de Acesso


3.1. Instrução formal – Formação Superior em Administração, Engenharia, Arquitetura ou cursos similares

3.2. Instrução complementar como diferencial – Cursos ou treinamentos relacionados à gestão condominial, administração financeira;

3.3 Facilidade de relacionamento;

3.4 Proatividade e iniciativa na resolução e problemas;

3.5 Saber convencer com ideias e dados;

3.6 Assertividade;

3.7 Capacidade de se adaptar a diferentes situações;

3.8 Lidar com mudanças no mercado e ser proativo na busca de soluções;

3.9 Empatia e capacidade de resiliência;

3.10 Desejo de aprender continuamente sobre o setor;

3.11 Conduta ética, respeitando a confidencialidade e agindo com integridade em todas as interações;

3.12 Colaboração eficaz com outros membros, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho harmoniosos;

3.13 Adesão as regrar e procedimentos estabelecidos;

3.14 Atitude positiva e comprometimento com a excelência.


Interessado(a)? Envie seu currículo para ou através do link e venha fazer parte de uma equipe de sucesso!

description:
Na RPS temos um compromisso com a excelência e a satisfação do cliente. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais experientes e dedicados que ajudam no desenvolvimento de serviços no mercado imobiliário.


Descrição da Vaga – (Assistente de Operações - Alphaville e região)

O Assistente de Operações, desempenha um papel crucial no suporte ao Gestor Condominial, concentrando-se na gestão eficiente da rotina administrativa e financeira do condomínio. 


Atuando como o elo estratégico entre o Departamento Financeiro da RPS e as nuances do dia a dia do condomínio, o profissional se destaca pela habilidade em manter uma comunicação fluida e eficaz. Respeitando com precisão as diretrizes e normas estabelecidas pela empresa, o Assistente de Operações é encarregado de garantir a conformidade dos procedimentos e processos implantados. Além disso, é esperado que o profissional compartilhe proativamente suas percepções, desafios e ideias com o Gestor Condominial, contribuindo para a evolução constante das práticas operacionais.

title: JDE Functional Finance Lead
description:
We’re looking for an experienced JDE Functional Finance Lead to join our team and play a key role in supporting and optimizing JD Edwards Financial processes. This role is ideal for a hands-on finance systems professional with strong functional expertise in GL, AP, Tax, and regulatory compliance .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support JD Edwards (JDE) Financial modules , including GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, and Tax
  • Partner with Finance, Tax, Audit, and IT teams to ensure accurate and compliant financial processes
  • Translate business requirements into functional system solutions
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulations, tax rules, and internal controls
  • Lead testing (UAT), enhancements, and system improvements
  • Provide functional guidance, training, and ongoing support to finance users
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate financial processes


Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong functional experience with JD Edwards Financials
  • Proven expertise in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Tax
  • Solid understanding of financial regulations and compliance
  • Experience leading or supporting JDE implementations or upgrades
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and business teams
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Information Systems
  • Experience in multi-entity or multi-country financial environments
  • Prior experience as a functional lead or subject matter expert

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML)
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Remote : Contract


The Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing) plays a crucial role in the development and deployment of innovative machine learning solutions for retail pricing that includes understanding various customer and operational business constraints and translating complex real-world problems into well-defined mathematical objectives


✅ Minimum Requirements: - PhD or Masters degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operation Research or related field - 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning, 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale

- Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design

- Proficiency with scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas, polars) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (ScikitLearn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)

- Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets

- Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)

- Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure - Fluency in Python, SQL

title: iOS Developer
description:
About the Company


Welcome to Going Merry! Founded in 2014, we are a mobile application development company with over 50 million downloads across 100+ apps. Our team operates from dynamic hubs including US, Dubai, London, Lisbon, and Milan, combining creativity and technology to deliver engaging mobile experiences.


At Going Merry, we value flexibility and collaboration. We offer remote work options that empower our diverse, global team to innovate while maintaining a strong sense of connection and ownership.


About the Role

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
Sobre a Nuvia


A Nuvia é a plataforma de AI-Powered Growth para vendas B2B. No ano passado, fechamos uma rodada com NXTP Ventures, Gilgamesh Ventures, 16|16 Ventures, LASP Capital e o scout fund da a16z e logo depois adquirimos a Datasaga.ai (consultoria de dados e IA para vendas) para acelerar nossa operação.

Não vendemos promessa, entregamos pipeline. Com isso, nossos clientes têm em média, +35% de conversão e -50% no custo de aquisição de clientes.

Agora estamos expandindo o time que vai escalar isso para centenas de empresas (nacionais e internacionais). Se você quer ajudar construir a máquina de vendas do futuro (e não só operar ferramentas) esse é o seu lugar.


Seu Papel


Como RevOps Specialist ou GTM Engineer, você vai ser o motor de execução das campanhas de outbound dos nossos clientes. Não é sobre fazer spam, é sobre construir sistemas que transformam estratégia em pipeline de forma escalável e replicável.

Você vai operar na interseção de dados, automação e vendas. Se você não sabe o que é um waterfall de enriquecimento, se nunca montou uma sequência multicanal do zero, ou se acha que "automação" é fazer um Zap básico - essa vaga não é pra você.

O que você vai fazer


  • Construir e operar campanhas multicanal (LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp) do zero ao resultado
  • Criar workflows de automação para enriquecimento, scoring, roteamento e sequenciamento de leads
  • Integrar ferramentas via APIs, webhooks e automações (CRM ↔ outbound ↔ enrichment)
  • Analisar performance e otimizar campanhas com base em métricas reais (reply rate, positive reply, meetings booked, pipeline gerado)
  • Garantir higiene de CRM — dados limpos, pipelines organizados, propriedades padronizadas
  • Otimizar prompts de agentes de Outbound para criação de estratégias e copies.
  • Documentar playbooks para escalar a operação sem depender de você


Quem você é hoje


Você é RevOps Analyst, Growth Engineer, Sales Ops ou GTM Ops em uma startup B2B SaaS com outbound estruturado, agência de outbound/lead gen, ou consultoria HubSpot/Salesforce.

Você já montou campanhas que geraram pipeline de verdade — não só volume. Entende o processo comercial e sabe traduzir isso em fluxos técnicos que rodam sozinhos.

Ou: Você era SDR/BDR e migrou para ops porque percebeu que escala vem de sistemas, não de força bruta. Você automatizou seu próprio trabalho antes de mudar de função.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • 2-4 anos de experiência em RevOps, Sales Ops, Growth Ops ou GTM Ops (B2B SaaS ou agência)
  • N8N avançado - workflows de enriquecimento, roteamento, scoring, integrações. Não só triggers básicos.
  • Python básico - scripts de transformação de dados, chamadas de API, manipulação de listas
  • SQL básico - Queries básicas para análise, extração e limpeza de dados. Você não precisa saber fazer tudo, mas se não souber, precisa explicar muito bem a uma IA como fazer.
  • CRM avançado - workflows, custom properties, APIs, integrações, relatórios. Não "já usei". Mas "já construí".
  • Experiência real com outbound - já operou campanhas que geraram reuniões qualificadas, não só disparos em massa


Diferenciais que pesam

  • Experiência com Clay (enrichment, waterfalls, AI personalization), Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist ou outras ferramentas de automação de Outbound.
  • Já integrou CRMs com ferramentas de outbound via API.
  • Conhecimento de APIs de scraping de dados.
  • Certificações HubSpot, RD, Salesforce ou outras.
  • Background em agência de outbound ou consultoria HubSpot.
  • Já desenvolveu aplicações de Hubspot ou outros CRMs.
  • Inglês ou espanhol intermediário.


O que você NÃO é

  • SDR que quer "subir de cargo" mas nunca automatizou nada;
  • Marketeiro que só sabe dar aula mas nunca construiu nada que funcione;
  • Dev que nunca viu um pipeline de vendas de perto;
  • Pessoa que precisa de especificação detalhada pra começar a resolver um problema.


Modelo de contratação e Benefícios

  • Remuneração competitiva com variável AGRESSIVÃO.
  • Benefícios de saúde/alimentação
  • Verba para cursos e formações em Vendas/Automações/AI e todos os assuntos correlatos.
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto ou híbrido (disponibilidade para calls em horário comercial BR)

title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of Development and Production support experience
  • .NET Core 8/C#: Proven ability to read, understand, and debug code written in .NET Core 8 (or a very recent version like .NET 6/7) and C#.
  • Visual Studio Proficiency: Strong familiarity with the Visual Studio IDE for debugging, navigating, and inspecting code.
  • Advanced Observability Tools:
  • New Relic: Proven experience using New Relic APM for application monitoring and proficiency in writing complex NRQL queries.
  • CloudWatch: Expert-level skill in analyzing logs via CloudWatch Logs Insights for diagnostics.
  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Demonstrated experience in applying methodical problem-solving to complex, high-traffic applications.
  • API Testing Tools: Hands-on experience using Postman for testing APIs and simulating payloads.

Nice to Have

  • AWS Services: Familiarity with the core Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure:
  • Compute: AWS Lambda and EC2
  • Data & Messaging: SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, and S3
  • Networking Fundamentals: Understanding of HTTP/S protocols and common request routing and integration patterns.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Consultor SAP Basis


Buscamos um Consultor SAP Basis qualificado e proativo para gerenciar, manter e otimizar sistemas SAP em um cenário RISE com SAP. Esta função exige experiência prática com ambientes SAP hospedados em nuvem, especialmente em plataformas como SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Analytics Cloud e integração com hiperescaladores (AWS, Azure, GCP). O candidato ideal garantirá alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos aplicativos SAP e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com provedores SAP e de nuvem.


Responsabilidades:


  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a Equipe de Especialistas do Cliente no escritório do cliente.
  • Experiência com HANA (obrigatório)
  • Gerenciar operações técnicas para SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP BW/4HANA.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Operações de Nuvem SAP, provedores de nuvem e equipes de TI do cliente.
  • Apoiar projetos de migração para o RISE com SAP (integração, conversão de sistemas, atividades de migração para a nuvem).
  • Gerencie a administração de usuários, o gerenciamento de transporte, cópias do sistema, backups, restaurações, aplicação de patches e atualizações.
  • Configure e monitore o SAP Cloud ALM, o Solution Manager ou o Focused Run, conforme apropriado para monitoramento centrado na nuvem.
  • Implemente as melhores práticas de segurança SAP, incluindo o fortalecimento do sistema e as autorizações de usuários.
  • Analise o desempenho do sistema e proponha otimizações.
  • Participe do gerenciamento de incidentes e problemas, análise de causa raiz e monitoramento proativo.
  • Gerencie cortes técnicos para implementações ou atualizações do SAP no ambiente RISE.
  • Crie e mantenha documentação técnica, incluindo runbooks operacionais.
  • Mantenha-se atualizado com as inovações SAP (roadmap RISE, serviços SAP BTP, ofertas de hiperescala).


Requisitos:


  • Experiência como Consultor SAP Basis.
  • Experiência com HANA db. (obrigatório)
  • Inglês avançado

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
A Toronto-based agency is seeking intermediate Full-stack developers to join their global technology group. This agency lives at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity to provide clients with high-performing campaigns and digital products that shape connected customer experiences. They've helped their clients implement fully integrated CRM customer journeys, built robust digital experiences, and created national loyalty programs with decades of experience in sectors of automotive, financial, telco and retail.


Responsibilities: Designing and developing user interfaces (UIs): This involves translating design mockups into actual web pages using HTML, CSS, Component Libraries, and React with Typescript. ● Creating responsive and interactive web pages: Ensuring websites look good and function smoothly on all devices (desktops, tablets, and phones).

● Optimizing website performance: Making sure websites load quickly and efficiently.

● Writing server-side code: Using languages like Javascript, Typescript on Node.js to handle data storage, retrieval, and processing.

● Developing APIs (Application Programming Interfaces): Creating interfaces that allow different applications to communicate with each other.

● Managing databases: Designing, implementing, and maintaining databases to store and organize data.

● Testing: Writing and updating Jest unit tests and Cypress E2E tests to ensure strong test-driven development.

● Understanding the entire web development process: Having a holistic view of how the front-end and back-end work together.

● Troubleshooting and debugging issues: Being able to identify and fix problems that may arise in any part of the application.

● Working with different technologies: Being proficient in a variety of programming languages, frameworks, and tools.

● Communicating with Stakeholders: Reporting on progress to agile pod teammates, and clients.

● Creating Unit Tests: Create automated Jest unit tests and ensure appropriate test coverage


Required Skills:

Knowledge of best practices and writing Clean Code

● 3+ years of working knowledge with modern frameworks and languages (REACT & NodeJS)

● Comfortable in the command line (Mac)

● Experience with GraphQL and Apollo

● Can build a prototype and is able to take it to production (kind of mindset)

● You can demonstrate experience from at least one large scale project

● Motivation to learn and be on the forefront of current technology standards and practices

● Ability to rapidly pick up new concepts and technologies

● Familiarity with working with different CMS integrations and building out clean content structures

title: Analista em Power BI Sênior
description:
Objetivo da Posição


Atuar como referência técnica em Power BI , sendo responsável por análises avançadas de dados, modelagem analítica e desenvolvimento de dashboards estratégicos , garantindo confiabilidade, governança e clareza na entrega de insights para apoio à tomada de decisão. O profissional terá papel ativo na liderança técnica de demandas complexas e na orientação do time de dados.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir análises avançadas de dados , transformando informações em insights estratégicos para o negócio.
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI , com foco em performance, usabilidade e storytelling.
  • Criar e otimizar modelos de dados analíticos , aplicando boas práticas de modelagem e relacionamento.
  • Implementar DAX avançado para cálculos complexos, indicadores e métricas de negócio.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Power Query (M) e Dataflows .
  • Atuar na otimização de performance de relatórios, modelos e datasets.
  • Realizar integrações com bancos de dados e APIs , garantindo consistência e qualidade das informações.
  • Garantir governança, segurança, parametrização e versionamento no Power BI Service.
  • Apoiar o time como referência técnica , revisando soluções, orientando boas práticas e liderando demandas de maior complexidade.
  • Participar de iniciativas de ETL/ELT , colaborando com times de engenharia e arquitetura de dados.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Domínio avançado de Power BI .
  • Experiência comprovada com:
  • DAX avançado
  • Power Query / M
  • Dataflows
  • Modelagem de dados analíticos
  • Otimização de performance
  • Experiência sólida com SQL , incluindo consultas complexas, joins, CTEs e funções analíticas.
  • Conhecimento em integrações com múltiplas fontes de dados , bancos relacionais e APIs.
  • Vivência com governança, segurança (RLS), parametrização e gestão de ambientes no Power BI Service.
  • Experiência em processos de ETL/ELT .


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura de dados e ambientes em nuvem, como:
  • Azure
  • Data Lake
  • Synapse Analytics ou soluções similares.

title: Analista em Power BI Sênior
description:
Objetivo da Posição


Atuar como referência técnica em Power BI , sendo responsável por análises avançadas de dados, modelagem analítica e desenvolvimento de dashboards estratégicos , garantindo confiabilidade, governança e clareza na entrega de insights para apoio à tomada de decisão. O profissional terá papel ativo na liderança técnica de demandas complexas e na orientação do time de dados.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir análises avançadas de dados , transformando informações em insights estratégicos para o negócio.
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI , com foco em performance, usabilidade e storytelling.
  • Criar e otimizar modelos de dados analíticos , aplicando boas práticas de modelagem e relacionamento.
  • Implementar DAX avançado para cálculos complexos, indicadores e métricas de negócio.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Power Query (M) e Dataflows .
  • Atuar na otimização de performance de relatórios, modelos e datasets.
  • Realizar integrações com bancos de dados e APIs , garantindo consistência e qualidade das informações.
  • Garantir governança, segurança, parametrização e versionamento no Power BI Service.
  • Apoiar o time como referência técnica , revisando soluções, orientando boas práticas e liderando demandas de maior complexidade.
  • Participar de iniciativas de ETL/ELT , colaborando com times de engenharia e arquitetura de dados.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Domínio avançado de Power BI .
  • Experiência comprovada com:
  • DAX avançado
  • Power Query / M
  • Dataflows
  • Modelagem de dados analíticos
  • Otimização de performance
  • Experiência sólida com SQL , incluindo consultas complexas, joins, CTEs e funções analíticas.
  • Conhecimento em integrações com múltiplas fontes de dados , bancos relacionais e APIs.
  • Vivência com governança, segurança (RLS), parametrização e gestão de ambientes no Power BI Service.
  • Experiência em processos de ETL/ELT .


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimentos em arquitetura de dados e ambientes em nuvem, como:
  • Azure
  • Data Lake
  • Synapse Analytics ou soluções similares.

title: Tibco Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (preferred);
  • 3+ years of experience with TIBCO and in Middleware or system integration environments;
  • Knowledge of TIBCO BusinessWorks version 5 or newer;
  • B2 English is mandatory;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Senior Business Manager
description:
1. Be responsible for the development of the local non-ferrous mineral market in the target country (products include but are not limited to: copper, lead, zinc, lithium, nickel, etc.), contact and visit customers of mining resources, factory customers and customers of export business, and maintain customer relationships regularly;


2. Assist the company in maintaining relationships with existing clients, handling, reporting and resolving unexpected issues during business advancement.


3. Actively maintain communication and coordination with local ports and relevant government departments to ensure the smooth operation of business.


4. Have a global perspective to empower overseas business;


5. Other tasks assigned by leaders.

3. Outgoing personality, with a strong sense of personal achievement and self-motivation, and a strong sense of career.

title: 3D Designer - Cinema 4D Specialist (Product, Commercial)
description:
Contractor/Freelance Position | 100% Remote (Full-Time)


We are specifically looking to review portfolios from individuals based in Brazil and Argentina .


About the role

We are seeking a talented Cinema 4D Designer to join our Creative team, specializing in high-fidelity, marketing-grade 3D rendering, imagery, and product animation. This role is responsible for generating stunning, hyper-realistic 3D visuals, clean motion assets, and sophisticated compositing work (photomontages) across our diverse portfolio of brands. This position requires exceptional skill in achieving professional authenticity and meticulous attention to detail. You will collaborate closely with Graphic Designers and other team members to translate creative concepts into precise, high-quality visuals, ensuring consistent and professional execution for all our business-focused content.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-end, hyper-realistic product and lifestyle scenes, including advanced image compositing (photomontages), from various reference materials.
  • Create professional 3D product animations (e.g., product rotations, camera moves, and simple showcases).
  • Help us set new standards for the modeling, texturing, lighting of our products, with an absolute dedication to visual authenticity.
  • Accurately translate design concepts into detailed 3D models.
  • Develop high-resolution final images and video assets of rendered content.
  • Successfully balance and prioritise multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines.
  • Work with varied project briefs, cooperate with Graphic Designers, and support the wider Creative team.
  • Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, adapting to the distinct visual approaches required for our various brands.
  • Uphold design standards, including consistent file-naming structures and meticulous folder organisation.


Requirements

  • Mandatory: Expert proficiency in Cinema 4D. Please note that this is a strict requirement; we are not seeking users of Blender, 3ds Max, or Maya for this role. Experience with Octane Render is highly preferred.
  • You possess a strong portfolio that showcases expertise in high-definition, commercial-style 3D visualizations, expert image compositing, and 3D animation. Portfolios focused only on character design, game assets, or abstract/fantasy scenes are not suitable for this role.
  • Mandatory: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required. You must be able to fluently communicate and clearly articulate technical 3D constraints to non-technical team members.
  • You have 4+ years’ experience as a 3D designer. Ideally, you’ll have worked in a graphic/animation studio, advertising agency, or an in-house creative department and have some experience working with beauty or wellness products.
  • You possess a proactive interest in emerging 3D technologies and have a willingness to explore AI-powered tools to optimize workflows and push creative boundaries.
  • You are capable of assessing a brief and determining the most effective execution strategy - knowing when to push for technical excellence and when to utilise smart shortcuts to meet tight turnarounds.
  • You are educated to degree level in Design or a related subject (e.g., Graphic Design, Product Design, Animation, or Motion Design).
  • You are proficient in modeling and texturing, and can create stunning, life-like visual assets of packaging, single products, and detailed marketing scenes. Your output must demonstrate strict adherence to photographic quality and detail.
  • You have expertise in lighting set-up, colour, and shading, with a keen focus on optimal product presentation to achieve visual authenticity.
  • You have a superb sense of composition, visual veracity (truthfulness), texture, and illumination, and a sophisticated understanding of materials. You can view products from a customer's perspective.
  • You are highly skilled with Adobe Photoshop (essential for compositing/photomontages) and knowledgeable about the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • You can effectively plan, prioritise, and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


To apply:

Please submit your CV and portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: 3D Designer - Cinema 4D Specialist (Product, Commercial)
description:
Contractor/Freelance Position | 100% Remote (Full-Time)


We are specifically looking to review portfolios from individuals based in Brazil and Argentina .


About the role

We are seeking a talented Cinema 4D Designer to join our Creative team, specializing in high-fidelity, marketing-grade 3D rendering, imagery, and product animation. This role is responsible for generating stunning, hyper-realistic 3D visuals, clean motion assets, and sophisticated compositing work (photomontages) across our diverse portfolio of brands. This position requires exceptional skill in achieving professional authenticity and meticulous attention to detail. You will collaborate closely with Graphic Designers and other team members to translate creative concepts into precise, high-quality visuals, ensuring consistent and professional execution for all our business-focused content.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-end, hyper-realistic product and lifestyle scenes, including advanced image compositing (photomontages), from various reference materials.
  • Create professional 3D product animations (e.g., product rotations, camera moves, and simple showcases).
  • Help us set new standards for the modeling, texturing, lighting of our products, with an absolute dedication to visual authenticity.
  • Accurately translate design concepts into detailed 3D models.
  • Develop high-resolution final images and video assets of rendered content.
  • Successfully balance and prioritise multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines.
  • Work with varied project briefs, cooperate with Graphic Designers, and support the wider Creative team.
  • Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, adapting to the distinct visual approaches required for our various brands.
  • Uphold design standards, including consistent file-naming structures and meticulous folder organisation.


Requirements

  • Mandatory: Expert proficiency in Cinema 4D. Please note that this is a strict requirement; we are not seeking users of Blender, 3ds Max, or Maya for this role. Experience with Octane Render is highly preferred.
  • You possess a strong portfolio that showcases expertise in high-definition, commercial-style 3D visualizations, expert image compositing, and 3D animation. Portfolios focused only on character design, game assets, or abstract/fantasy scenes are not suitable for this role.
  • Mandatory: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required. You must be able to fluently communicate and clearly articulate technical 3D constraints to non-technical team members.

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
Apricot Jam


Apricot Jam is a US based consulting and technology company working with Fortune 500 and large enterprise clients worldwide. We design and deliver next generation enterprise solutions combining ServiceNow, AI driven automation, and strong engineering practices.


Our teams operate across Europe the US and Asia, working in a culture that values ownership, curiosity, and continuous growth. We believe great software is built by people who care deeply about quality, collaboration, and impact.


Role Overview


We are looking for skilled ServiceNow Developers to join our growing delivery team. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building modern enterprise applications and want to work across advanced ServiceNow capabilities including UI Builder, AI Agent Studio, App Engine, and ERP focused integrations.


You will work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, and client stakeholders to design and implement scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. The more of the skills below you bring, the more impact you can have.


What You Will Do


• Design configure and develop custom solutions on the ServiceNow platform

• Build modern user experiences using UI Builder and Next Experience

• Develop applications using App Engine including ERP related use cases

• Configure and extend workflows using Flow Designer and platform automation

• Implement integrations using IntegrationHub REST and Zero Copy Connector patterns

• Work with AI Agent Studio and Now Assist related capabilities where applicable

• Translate business requirements into clean scalable technical solutions

• Participate in technical workshops solution reviews and demos

• Collaborate with global teams across Europe and the US

• Contribute to best practices performance optimization and platform governance


Required and Desired Skills


• 3 plus years of hands on ServiceNow development experience

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

• Strong JavaScript skills including client and server side scripting

• Experience with one or more of the following is highly valued

• UI Builder and custom workspace development

• AI Agent Studio or Now Assist related configurations

• App Engine Studio and custom application development

• ERP related ServiceNow use cases

• ERP Canvas and Zero Copy Connector experience

• Solid understanding of ServiceNow data models security and performance

• Experience with Flow Designer IntegrationHub and APIs

• Ability to work in a client facing environment


Certifications are a strong plus

• CSA CAD

• CIS certifications ITSM CSM HRSD ITAM or App Engine


Why Join Apricot Jam


• Work on complex high impact ServiceNow implementations for US enterprise clients

• Be part of a senior globally distributed ServiceNow team

• Exposure to cutting edge ServiceNow capabilities including AI and ERP integrations

• Support for certifications learning and career growth

• Competitive compensation based on experience and contribution

• A people first culture built on trust autonomy and collaboration

title: Clinical Trainer LATAM
description:
About Lumenis

Lumenis is a world leader in laser- and light-based technologies for medical and aesthetic applications. Ever since introducing the first medical laser system in the world nearly 45 years ago, Lumenis has been at the forefront of technological innovation and market leadership in its segment. Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world. The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.


About the role:

As a Clinical trainer, reporting to the Clinical Training Director, you will be responsible for the development and deployment of clinical training for Lumenis customers, distributors and field employees. This position also involves overseeing every detail of training logistics to guarantee smooth and successful training sessions.


Main Duties:

  • Collaborate closely with the Clinical Training Director to implement and uphold rigorous high quality standards in training
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential customers (digital and onsite).
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential distributors’-affiliated clinical trainers and follow-them up
  • Coordinate all local clinical events.
  • Demonstrate use/ benefits of Lumenis products to the customers.
  • Proactive involvement with the new changing needs of digital engagement.
  • Ensure that all training programs meet the required regulations and standards.
  • Innovate the current educational offering for salesforce and customers to a digital platform.
  • contribute to the global effort in producing collaterals such as but not limited to blog, newsletter, application notes etc


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience or training in the medical device industry; preferable experience in the aesthetics field - an advantage.
  • Experience in preparing and adjusting clinical presentations as per audience and allocated time.
  • Accurate in delivering training messaging.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Must be willing to travel throughout LATAM region – around 70%. and exceptionally outer LATAM
  • Interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Results- driven and self-motivated.
  • Highly organized and detail oriented.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Cooperate with others, teamwork.
  • Enthusiastic about gaining new knowledge and dedicated to self-improvement by regular engagement in professional development activities (such as but not limited to gathering clinical updates from scientific journals)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese will be considered an advantage

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer with a strong experience implementing apps with the languages and frameworks created by Apple for iOS and Google for Android.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • 5+ years experience on native mobile development across both platforms: iOS and Android
  • iOS development with SwiftUI
  • Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Senior Solution Architect (Remote)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ Descrição:

Você liderará decisões arquiteturais de produtos e plataformas críticas, definindo conceitos fundamentais, elementos e relações do sistema conforme boas práticas de arquitetura. Você conectará estratégia de produto a soluções cloud‑native escaláveis, seguras e observáveis, promovendo governança técnica, redução de dívida e eficiência de custos (FinOps).


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Definir e evoluir arquitetura (microserviços/event‑driven, APIs) com ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), padrões e guias — reduzindo retrabalho e melhorando coerência entre equipes.
  • Estabelecer SLIs/SLOs (Service Level Indicators / Service Level Objectives) e observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces com OpenTelemetry) para diagnóstico ágil e MTTR menor.
  • Planejar capacidade, desempenho e resiliência (caching, tolerância a falhas, back‑pressure) — melhorando disponibilidade.
  • Eleger tecnologias (Azure/AWS/GCP, bancos relacionais/noSQL, mensageria) com análise de trade‑offs e custo total de propriedade.
  • Governança técnica: promover boas práticas (DDD, testes, segurança por design), revisões arquiteturais e quality gates em CI/CD.
  • Segurança/Privacidade: aplicar OAuth2/OIDC, criptografia, gestão de segredos e princípios LGPD.
  • FinOps: co‑liderar otimização de uso e rates (tagueamento, unit economics), equilibrando custo vs. performance.
  • Mentoria e influência: apoiar tech leads, alinhar com PO/PM, SRE/Operações e Segurança; comunicar riscos, dependências e impactos.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Arquiteturas distribuídas (microserviços, event‑driven) e APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Event‑driven architecture: modelar domínios e eventos, Kafka (tópicos/partições, schema registry, DLQ), RabbitMQ — aumentando resiliência e throughput.
  • Plataformas de integração: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) e/ou OSB/ODI/CDC (OGG).
  • Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), Containers & Orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e IaC (Terraform/Helm).
  • Observabilidade e SLIs/SLOs; instrumentação e dashboards (ex.: Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry).
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/GitLab), qualidade (SonarQube) e segurança (SAST/DAST).
  • Bancos de dados (PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis), modelagem e performance.
  • Segurança por design e LGPD.


❇️ Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Computação/Engenharia de Software/SI (ou experiência equivalente).


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e de negócio
  • Colaboração e influência sem autoridade; facilitação de decisões
  • Pensamento sistêmico e análise de trade‑offs; mentoria
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Colaboração
  • Foco no cliente
  • Visão de dono


❇️ Qualificações preferenciais:

  • Event sourcing, sagas, gRPC, estratégias blue/green/canary.
  • Práticas SRE (erro budget, post‑mortem) e FinOps avançado.
  • Certificações: Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), CKA/CKAD, TOGAF (contexto EA), DASA/DevOps, SRE.


✨O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada;
  • Trilha de carreira.

  • Estabelecer SLIs/SLOs (Service Level Indicators / Service Level Objectives) e observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces com OpenTelemetry) para diagnóstico ágil e MTTR menor.
  • Planejar capacidade, desempenho e resiliência (caching, tolerância a falhas, back‑pressure) — melhorando disponibilidade.
  • Eleger tecnologias (Azure/AWS/GCP, bancos relacionais/noSQL, mensageria) com análise de trade‑offs e custo total de propriedade.
  • Governança técnica: promover boas práticas (DDD, testes, segurança por design), revisões arquiteturais e quality gates em CI/CD.
  • Segurança/Privacidade: aplicar OAuth2/OIDC, criptografia, gestão de segredos e princípios LGPD.
  • FinOps: co‑liderar otimização de uso e rates (tagueamento, unit economics), equilibrando custo vs. performance.
  • Mentoria e influência: apoiar tech leads, alinhar com PO/PM, SRE/Operações e Segurança; comunicar riscos, dependências e impactos.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Arquiteturas distribuídas (microserviços, event‑driven) e APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Event‑driven architecture: modelar domínios e eventos, Kafka (tópicos/partições, schema registry, DLQ), RabbitMQ — aumentando resiliência e throughput.
  • Plataformas de integração: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) e/ou OSB/ODI/CDC (OGG).
  • Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), Containers & Orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e IaC (Terraform/Helm).
  • Observabilidade e SLIs/SLOs; instrumentação e dashboards (ex.: Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry).
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/GitLab), qualidade (SonarQube) e segurança (SAST/DAST).
  • Bancos de dados (PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis), modelagem e performance.
  • Segurança por design e LGPD.


❇️ Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Computação/Engenharia de Software/SI (ou experiência equivalente).


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e de negócio
  • Colaboração e influência sem autoridade; facilitação de decisões
  • Pensamento sistêmico e análise de trade‑offs; mentoria
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Colaboração
  • Foco no cliente
  • Visão de dono


❇️ Qualificações preferenciais:

  • Event sourcing, sagas, gRPC, estratégias blue/green/canary.
  • Práticas SRE (erro budget, post‑mortem) e FinOps avançado.
  • Certificações: Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), CKA/CKAD, TOGAF (contexto EA), DASA/DevOps, SRE.

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

title: Analista GIS Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga


  • Analisar, planejar e executar as atividades da área de Customer Success da Diretoria de Experiência do Cliente, com foco na satisfação e sucesso dos clientes.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Ajudar o cliente a alcançar os objetivos idealizados com a compra de nossa plataforma;
  • Gerir o Onboarding;
  • Upsell & Cross Sell;
  • Reuniões de tomada de decisão e projetos;
  • Propor as melhores soluções aos clientes, sejam mudanças ou manutenções;
  • Follow ups frequentes sobre o andamento do projeto dos clientes;
  • Avaliar indicadores de performance e resultados dos clientes;
  • Colher feedbacks sobre o produto ou serviço;
  • Elaborar e apresentar reports para que o cliente fique ciente de onde está e para onde vai;
  • Nutrir o cliente com informações sobre a plataforma de forma estratégica;
  • Gerenciar conflitos de expectativa, solucionando eventuais problemas e acionando as áreas envolvidas, incluindo à Qualidade Imagem para melhorias contínuas de nossos processos;
  • Garantir a utilização completa da plataforma de acordo com os objetivos do cliente;
  • Fazer a ponte entre os feedbacks dos clientes e operação/comercial/marketing/fornecedores.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado em Ciências da Terra.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Atendimento a clientes internos e externos;
  • Conceitos básicos das metodológicas de Customer Experience e Customer Success;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Vivência em projetos;
  • Conhecimento em TI (Banco de Dados e automações com Python);
  • Conhecimento sólido em ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise e aplicativos como Survey, Dashboards etc.);
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de recursos naturais ou geomarketing (ambiental, mineração, óleo e gás).

Atuar como ponto central na facilitação e gestão de ideias e demandas por meio do Teams Ideas , garantindo organização, priorização estratégica, alinhamento entre áreas e comunicação clara.   • Atuar na interface entre áreas de negócio, tecnologia e governança, garantindo fluidez na comunicação e execução das demandas.
  • Apoiar a melhoria contínua dos processos de gestão de ideias e demandas.

  • Experiência sólida com Teams Ideas ou plataformas similares de gestão de ideias, demandas ou inovação.

  • Experiência comprovada em facilitação de reuniões, workshops e cerimônias organizacionais .
  • Conhecimento prático em frameworks de priorização (RICE, MoSCoW, Matriz de Valor, 5W2H).
  • Conhecimentos intermediários ou avançados em Microsoft 365 (Teams, Planner, SharePoint, OneNote, Excel, entre outros).
  • Capacidade de criar e manter documentação estruturada e objetiva .


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento ou vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake
description:
Title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake

Location: Remote Mexico/Brazi

Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications


Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.


Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Qualifications


Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.


Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager (Remote | Contract)


We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to own delivery execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives in an agile engineering environment. This role sits at the center of business, product, and engineering — translating priorities into action, driving clarity, and ensuring work is delivered with quality and consistency.


This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, and keeping teams aligned and moving.


What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex initiatives, from planning through execution and completion
  • Build and manage delivery plans, including scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and resource coordination
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to manage work intake, backlog grooming, prioritization, and task tracking (Jira)
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing clear updates and driving alignment across teams
  • Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and adjust plans as priorities evolve
  • Facilitate working sessions, stand-ups, planning meetings, and stakeholder workshops as needed
  • Support prioritization decisions by providing delivery insights, trade-offs, and impact analysis
  • Continuously improve delivery processes, tools, and ways of working to increase efficiency and predictability
  • Track and report on delivery progress using appropriate metrics and tools


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience leading delivery for complex projects or initiatives
  • Strong experience working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience using Jira for backlog management and delivery tracking
  • Proven ability to work effectively with engineering teams and business stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working in a client-facing role
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and bring structure and clarity
  • Experience supporting prioritization, change management, and delivery trade-offs
  • Basic SQL skills and familiarity with finance or accounting concepts are a plus, but not required

title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer  to join the Customer Identity (CI) team that is central to the enterprise, focused on ensuring customer data is accurate, consistent, and readily accessible. This critical data is the foundation for essential business processes, including personalized marketing, analytical reporting, and seamless online and in-store checkout and customer service experiences.


They manage a wide array of high-performance, scalable batch and real-time services. These services are utilized at numerous customer interactions, such as in-store purchases, online orders, rewards program enrollments, and activations from various marketing channels (Email, Direct Mail, SMS, Push notifications, etc.). By leveraging modern development practices, tools, and technology platforms, the CI team builds capabilities that empower customer-facing and checkout teams to deliver personalized, relevant, and frictionless experiences, ensuring customers realize value with every interaction.


Core hours:

This team operates in every major US time zone from Pacific to Eastern. Core hours would be considered 10 am CST - 4 pm CST with 2 hours spilling over either direction based on location.


Required Skills:

Non-Negotiable Requirements
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java, particularly Spring Boot.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.


Tech Stack:  Java, Springboot, Redis, Relational Database (MySQL, Oracle), NoSQL Database (Mongo), Kafka, Cloud engineering (Docker/Kubernetes), Node.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, CSS, React, Angular, Testing framework (Junit, Jest).


Bonus Skills:

Experience with GCP suite (BigQuery), Airflow, and Web framework (Astro).


Duration:  3 months; end date being March 31, 2026, with the possibility of being extended based on team needs.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a leading retail innovator transforming the shopping experience through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.
